mapper.select: SELECT E.EDGE_ID, E.FOLDER_ID, E.SOURCE_MEMO_ID, E.TARGET_MEMO_ID, E.EDGE_TYPE, E.CREATED_AT FROM BOARD_EDGE E INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = E.FOLDER_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY E.CREATED_AT ASC, E.EDGE_ID ASC

SELECT E.EDGE_ID, E.FOLDER_ID, E.SOURCE_MEMO_ID, E.TARGET_MEMO_ID, E.EDGE_TYPE, E.CREATED_AT FROM BOARD_EDGE E INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = E.FOLDER_ID WHERE E.EDGE_ID = #{edgeId} AND F.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_EDGE ( FOLDER_ID, SOURCE_MEMO_ID, TARGET_MEMO_ID, EDGE_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{folderId}, #{sourceMemoId}, #{targetMemoId}, #{edgeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
